notes: Transcribed from the catalogue's Mwongozo Wa Vifupisho Vilivyotumika legend. English translations accompany the retained source codes; no new biological recommendation is inferred.

a.original: Tumbukiza mbegu kwenye maji yanayochemka kisha uziache ndani ya maji mpaka maji yapoe
a.english: Immerse seeds in boiling water, then leave them in the water until it cools.

b.original: Toboa gamba la mbegu kwa kutumia kitu chenye ncha kali ili kuruhusu maji yapenye
b.english: Pierce the seed coat with a sharp tool to allow water to penetrate.

c.original: Loweka mbegu kwenye maji baridi kwa masaa 24 mfululizo
c.english: Soak seeds in cold water for 24 hours.

d.original: Hakuna umuhimu wa maandalizi ya awali

e.original: Loweka mbegu kwenye maji baridi kwa masaa 6
e.english: Soak seeds in cold water for 6 hours.

g.original: Pasua gamba la mbegu kwa uangalifu ili maji yaweze kupenya kwenye mbegu kirahisi
g.english: Carefully crack the seed coat to allow water to penetrate.

h.original: Loweka mbegu kwenye maji yanayotembea kwa masaa 72
h.english: Soak seeds in running water for 72 hours.
